questions.question_text: Explain the difference between arable farming, pastoral farming and mixed farming. [3]

marking_scheme.rubric: AO1: Define the three farming types.
keywords_required: Arable farming focuses on growing crops (e.g. wheat, vegetables).
Pastoral farming focuses on rearing animals/livestock (e.g. cows, sheep).
Mixed farming involves both growing crops and rearing animals on the same farm.

questions.question_text: What are two examples of inputs used on a farm? [2]

keywords_required: Human/Economic inputs: machinery, seeds, fertilisers, pesticides, labour.

questions.question_text:
Fill in the gaps using the correct words from the list below: subsistence, commercial, arable.
a) ________ farming involves growing crops to sell for profit.
b) ________ farming produces just enough food for the farmer and their family.
c) ________ farming is the growing of crops, rather than raising livestock.

Are the following statements true or false?
a) Hydroponics grows plants using mist instead of water.
b) Aquaponics combines aquaculture with hydroponics.

keywords_required: a) False (Aeroponics uses mist; hydroponics uses nutrient-rich water).

questions.question_text: Give two examples of processes on an arable farm. [2]

keywords_required: Ploughing, sowing seeds, weeding, harvesting, irrigating.
